title: Sentencia de Genocidio y Delitos Contra los Deberes de Humanidad contra Efraín Ríos Montt
authors: Tribunal Primero de Sentencia Penal de Mayor Riesgo A
summary: Historic legal judgment by Guatemalan High-Risk Court finding former de facto head of state General Efraín Ríos Montt guilty of genocide and crimes against humanity for the systematic massacre of 1,771 Maya-Ixil indigenous civilians during Operation Sofía in 1982–1983, establishing command responsibility and the deliberate intent to destroy the group.
